description: Real-time price quote for one US stock symbol: current, change, %change, open, high, low, previous close. Pairs the quote with live market-status so the response states whether the price is live or the prior close — never implies a stale price is live. Resolve a name to a symbol with finnhub_search_symbols first. International symbols (with an exchange suffix like ".TO") are not on the free tier and return a clear error.

symbol.description: US stock ticker (e.g., "AAPL", "MSFT"). Resolve a company name with finnhub_search_symbols first. International symbols (with an exchange suffix like ".TO") are not on the free tier and return a clear error.

name: finnhub_get_quote

change.description: Absolute change vs. previous close. Null when the data is unavailable.

current.description: Current price when the market is open; the most recent close when it is not — read `priceIsLive`.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `symbol_not_found`: Quote sentinel detected (c=0, t=0, d=null, dp=null) — unknown US symbol at HTTP 200. `not_us_or_paid`: Upstream HTTP 403 — international or paid-only symbol. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

holiday.description: Finnhub holiday event name. Null when none is reported or status is unavailable.

marketOpen.description: Whether the US market is currently open. Null when the market-status check failed.

percentChange.description: Percent change vs. previous close. Null when unavailable.

priceIsLive.description: True only when the market is open. When false, `current` is the prior close, not a live price.

session.description: Finnhub market session. Null when Finnhub reports no active session or status is unavailable.

title: Finnhub Get Quote
